content.text: Go Mndewa Imulungu,
habali kokwima kutali?
Habali koifisa mna ikipindi cha magazo?
Mkibuli chake munhu yehile komsaka munhu yonyolila,
munhu yonyolila konamatwa mumtego wa munhu yehile.
Munhu yehile koigodela kusulukila mmoyo wake,
munhu mmelo komduwila na komuliga Mndewa Imulungu.
Munhu yehile, koitapa na hamzahila Imulungu,
heyo kogelegeza, “Haduhu Imulungu.”
Nzila za munhu yehile zogendelela goya,
kumwake heyo nhaguso zako za kutali na magesa gake,
na kowabezeli iwanhu omwihila.
Kogelegeza mmoyo wake, “Haduhu kinhu chonda kingaze,
sigaya bule muugima wangu.”
Mulomo wake umema kuduwila na uvizi na kunanga,
hakawa kulonga mbuli za kugevuza na gehile.
Koifisa ili yavamile kuna ivijiji,
hanhu ha kinyelegezi kowakoma iwanhu hawatendile dihile.
Kokala meso ili yamvamile mkiwa.
Koifisa kinyelegezi kamba simba yosaka,
koifisa ili yamvamile mkiwa.
Komgoga mkiwa yahamkwesela behi mna ulwavu lwake.
Mkiwa kovamiligwa na kobwanhigwa hasi,
kobwanhigwa kwa usede wa munhu yehile.
Kolonga mmoyo wake, “Imulungu kaisemwa,
kaifisa kihanga chake, na halola kinhu!”
Go Mndewa Imulungu winuke,
inula mkono wako uwakoboze,
sikuuwasemwe iwanhu odununzwa.
Habali imunhu yehile yambezeli Imulungu na kulonga mmoyo wake,
“Honda yanikeme nimpetele zinhendile.”
Lakini gweye kowalola iwanhu ogaya na kudununzwa,
na gweye kowataza siku zose.
Mkiwa kokutamanila gweye Imulungu,
gweye kowataza wana wakiwa.
Uzibene zinguvu za munhu yehile na imunhu yotenda ganyolodoke,
ugakoboze gehile gake mbaka sikuugone kabili.
Mndewa Imulungu ayo Mndewa siku zose na milele!
Iwanhu wa isi obanangigwa wasegele mwiisi yake.
Gweye Mndewa Imulungu, kuhulika viyopula imunhu mkiwa,
komgangamiza na komgwaa nguvu,
kotegeleza kililo chake.
Kowatendela ganogile iwana wakiwa na iwanhu odununzwa,
ili imunhu yeli ulongo tu sikuyawadumbize iwanhu.
